tasks.label: wait for blog debug readiness
tasks.command: $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(5); do { try { $blogResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:4000/blog/' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5 } catch { $blogResponse = $null }; try { $debugResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:9229/json/list' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5 } catch { $debugResponse = $null }; if (($blogResponse.StatusCode -eq 200) -and ($debugResponse.StatusCode -eq 200)) { exit 0 }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 } while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline); throw 'Blog and Node inspector did not become ready within 5 minutes.'
